ticker_news.title: Marjorie Taylor Greene Goes Shopping; Here Are 6 Stocks She Just Bought
ticker_news.description: Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene has been actively investing in various stocks, including AI companies like Apple, Intel, and Meta, as well as dividend-paying stocks like Devon Energy, Norfolk Southern, and UPS. The article analyzes the potential reasons behind her stock picks and provides insights for investors.
ticker_news.author: The Motley Fool

SPY.title: Federal Reserve's Preferred Inflation Gauge Marks First Slowdown In 4 Months
SPY.description: The Federal Reserve's key inflation measure, the Personal Consumption Expenditures price index, grew by 2.5% in January 2025, marking its first slowdown in four months. Core PCE, excluding food and energy, increased 2.6% from the same period last year.
SPY.author: Erica Kollmann
